why: Rosetta: the arXiv preprint of the PLOS ONE article also in the corpus as JATS (epmc-pone.0310152), publisher HTML (plos-pone.0310152), and Grobid TEI (grobid-pone.0310152); its authors typeset the title and abstract by hand, with no LaTeXML title or abstract markup. The title stays body text; the paragraph opening with a bold run-in "Abstract." is read as the abstract. Pins what it shares with the JATS parse: that title and abstract text, the top-level section sequence, one table, twelve figures, and 45 references.
abstractStartsWith: In this study, we present an immuno-epidemic model to understand mitigation options during an epidemic break.
